title: JEE Mains Maths
summary: JEE Mains Maths past questions, 2021 to 2026, five a day. Questions NTA asked again and the question types it keeps asking come first, ranked together by how often they were asked, then every other question.
note: Repeats are counted across sittings: 2021 papers, 2022-2025 exam days (the bank keeps both shifts of a day together) and 2026 shifts. Chapters NTA removed from the syllabus in 2024 are left out. Groups were found by a chapter-by-chapter reading (scripts/homework/REVIEW_BRIEF_JEE.md), made consistent and joined across chapters in the main session.
